head: 2c0084fe3c0245e7a2e8ae9138f8882b1852470f
note: PR #1486 (author vicoooo26) combines former #1481+#1482+#1483 and, because its base develop-v2 is the empty init commit, carries the ENTIRE cumulative v2 tree (140 files, ~28k insertions). It is the resubmission of the earlier 7-PR stack (#1477-#1483, all closed) as combined PRs #1484(closed)/#1485(closed)/#1486(open). Findings are seeded from the round-1 review on verify/v2-stack and re-proven against this head. Production code untouched; deliverable is additive test files + this docs dir.

findings.claim: Hand-rolled --set parser dropped intermediate-array values and panicked on nested array indices.
findings.observed: PASS: storages[0].name=data -> [{name:data}]; matrix[0][1]=x -> [[nil,"x"]] (no panic). setter.go rewritten with updateSliceInParent write-back + maxIndex OOM guard.

findings.claim: Single-node PyTorch submit that requests GPUs fails validation: buildSubmitTask nils Worker for --workers<=1, then ApplyOverrides.ensureWorker() resurrects Worker{Replicas:0}.
findings.proposedFix: Route resource flags (--gpus/--cpu/--memory) to Master when Worker is nil for single-node pytorch, or default ensureWorker Replicas=1.

findings.claim: ResolveMPIVersion re-wraps ErrCRDNotFound as a bare fmt.Errorf without %w (crd.go:72), so errors.Is(err, ErrCRDNotFound) is false at the layer callers use to distinguish 'operator not installed'.
findings.observed: FAIL: errors.Is == false; err="MPIJob CRD not found in cluster"
findings.proposedFix: return fmt.Errorf("MPIJob CRD not found in cluster: %w", ErrCRDNotFound)

findings.claim: test/e2e suite has no //go:build tag, so `go test ./...` includes it; BeforeSuite calls Fail() without a live cluster/binary. Only pkg/cli/integration_test.go is gated (//go:build integration).
findings.observed: FAIL: [BeforeSuite] CRD directory not found: crds — run `make v2-e2e-setup` first; Ran 0 of 52 Specs; FAIL github.com/kubeflow/arena/test/e2e
findings.proposedFix: Add `//go:build v2e2e` (or reuse `integration`) to every test/e2e/*.go file and document the tag in the Makefile e2e targets.

findings.claim: delete -f ignored the namespace declared in the YAML file.
findings.observed: delete.go now sets yamlNS=t.Namespace and calls resolveNS(yamlNS); resolveNS implements flag > YAML > kubeconfig > default.

findings.claim: MPI launcher log selector keys on replica-type=launcher; constants.LabelJobRole is defined but never used in production, suggesting the selector may have been intended to use job-role (standalone mpi-operator labels pods with training.kubeflow.org/job-role).
findings.observed: canary green: selector = training.kubeflow.org/job-name=myjob,training.kubeflow.org/replica-type=launcher; LabelJobRole unused. Needs operator-label confirmation before asserting a fix.

findings.claim: tensorboard=false through ApplyOverrides materializes a non-nil TensorBoardConfig (API-level footgun; currently CLI-gated so not reachable via submit).
setInt(n>0) guard prevents applying a negative priority (legal for k8s signed int32 PriorityClass) and prevents lowering priority to 0.
findings.observed: FAIL: priority override to -100 dropped, stayed 50
